This tool lets you discover which World Cup stars have roots near you, including present-day superstars and past greats from all four home nations since 1950. It highlights players' connections to their local areas, from Manchester's Nico O'Reilly to Sunderland-born Jordan Pickford.

It also notes that for many UK councils, the wait for a World Cup player continues.
